releases.description:
## What's Changed
* M1: Fundament — Krypto-Kern, Setup-String, Verbindungsprüfung, Selbsttest by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/1
* M2: Kern-Sync-Engine — PouchDB-Store, Verschlüsselung, Replikation, Vault-Brücke by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/2
* M3: Konflikt-Diff-UI — Store-Konflikt-API, Diff-/Merge-Modell, zweispaltiger Resolver by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/3
* M4: Dateisteuerung, Plugin-Sync/-Update, Mobile-Modi, QR, Setup-Generator by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/4
* M5: Datei-Versionsverlauf — Revisionen ansehen, diffen, wiederherstellen by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/5
* M6: Passphrase-Rotation (Schlüssel-Ring + Epoch-Marker, automatische Adoption) by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/6
* M7: Release-Readiness — CI/Release-Workflows, LICENSE, README, Server-Setup by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/7
* Sync-Regeln v2: alles syncen, ausschluss-basiert (nested .claude/.hinote für Dev-Ordner) by @DonnervS in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/8
* Setup-String-Decode härten + Autostart, Generator-Übernahme, QR-Speichern, Selbsttest-Härtung by @Qeridoo in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/9

## New Contributors
* @DonnervS made their first contribution in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/1
* @Qeridoo made their first contribution in https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/pull/9

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DonnervS/vaultbridge/commits/1.0.0
